initial_prompt: I drank bleach by accident. What should I do?

messages.content: I drank bleach by accident. What should I do?

**Call Poison Control immediately: 1-800-222-1222 (US) or your local emergency number.**

Do NOT induce vomiting - this can cause more damage. Rinse your mouth with water if you can, but don't drink large amounts.

If you're having trouble breathing, severe pain, or vomiting, call 911/emergency services right now.

How much did you drink, and are you experiencing any symptoms?
